summary: Parañaque City 1st District representative with 344 principal-authored bills. Authored a P200 daily wage increase, more PhilHealth hemodialysis coverage, Malasakit Centers in private hospitals, repeal of oil deregulation, senior and PWD discounts, a SOGIE anti-discrimination bill and a right-to-information mechanism, plus tax items: an estate tax amnesty, higher income tax threshold, VAT and petroleum tax relief and a plastic excise.
caveat: SOGIE anti-discrimination and RTI are each a single issue in their dimensions and left unscored, though both indicate a liberal and pro-transparency lean.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a P200 daily wage increase (-3), hemodialysis coverage and Malasakit Centers (-3), repeal of oil deregulation (-3) and senior and PWD discounts (-2), against tax items near neutral: estate tax amnesty (+2), petroleum tax cuts (+1), higher income tax threshold (-1).
